claims.head: Like for like: Miller against Guentzel
claims.call: The Rangers’ L2 (Miller, Kartye and Lafrenière) spends at least 39% of its 5-on-5 time against the Lightning’s second line.
claims.body: At home, the Rangers keep sending Miller’s line (Miller, Kartye and Lafrenière) out against opponents’ second lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Mike Sullivan keeps choosing line for line. Tonight the Lightning’s second line is Guentzel, Cirelli and Hagel.

claims.gist: At home, Mike Sullivan likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Lightning’s second line.

faceoff.text: A. Cirelli is sent out to take power-play faceoffs, then changes. He has taken 38% of the team’s power-play draws but stays on for about 28 seconds at a time, against 69 for the regulars, and is most often replaced by B. Hagel (8 of 12 changes).

notes.text: U. Vaakanainen has not played this season. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
